messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Ninth protocol. Command demands full separation. As long as it stays bonded to your trauma, it may reproduce your fears.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: But if we cut too fast, it may experience separation as an attack.

choices.label: I accept a clean separation. It must survive without me.
I refuse the brutal cut. It is not ready.
I propose gradual distance with verifiable markers.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: At ten meters, it panics. At fifteen, it freezes. At twenty, your hands shake like they did during Mirador.

choices.label: I hold the line to prove fear does not decide.
I turn the exercise into independence training.
I follow the mental image it sends during the distance.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: We have reached the sensitive point: loving it as a creature bonded to you, is that protection or captivity?

choices.label: I cut the bond. Its freedom matters more than my relief.
I keep the bond, but teach it not to wait for me.
I let the creature choose the distance it can bear.
